notes: The flame you get for finishing a lesson now actually burns. It ignites white-hot and settles into your streak colour, and its two sides move independently, so it writhes instead of sitting there being nudged. And the daily reminder no longer disappears just because you opened the app. Opening it re-anchored the reminder to tomorrow, which quietly cancelled the nudge you were still owed for today; if the time has passed and the lesson is not done, you now get it anyway. It also knows the difference between a lesson you have not started and one you left half finished, and asks you to continue rather than to start.
